description: Open-air plinth in the Bandar Hilir museum precinct, a few hundred metres east of the Royal Malaysian Navy Museum and beside the Melaka Islamic Museum. Delivered to the Royal Malayan Air Force on 18 January 1962 (c/n 583) and flown by No. 1 Squadron until 1974; named Lang Rajawali and celebrated as the RMAF's first aircraft type. Older sources place it in a Melaka Transport Museum (Muzium Pengangkutan Melaka) which no longer appears in the Melaka Museums Corporation listing. Photographed in good order in June 2018; a commenter reported it visibly deteriorated by January 2023. Year_built given as 1961 is the airframe's build year implied by the January 1962 delivery and should be treated as approximate.
aliases: Twin Pioneer CC.1; Twin Pin; FM-1064; c/n 583
